title: Probe feature transport by cross-model Mirror bridge
scope: Feature/probe transport only; not PA242 reproduction, broad semantic equivalence, or an end-to-end LLM stitching benchmark.

features.structural: GPT-2 token word-boundary indicator (token starts Ġ) versus continuation token; valid non-padding positions only.
features.semantic_lexical: Curated animal-word token indicator for dog, cat, puppy, kitten, bird, duck, rabbit, bunny, mouse, fox, bear, lion, tiger, elephant, horse, cow, sheep, pig, chicken, frog, turtle, fish, butterfly, owl, deer; only whole-word GPT-2 tokens.
features.negative_control: Train probe against deterministic shuffled labels with matched prevalence; evaluate against true held-out labels.

controls: independent affine connector per heldout pair/layer then target probe
factorized bridge then same target probe
metrics: per-family average precision and balanced accuracy

gates.signal: factorized transfer retains >=90% of native AP for both feature families in both directions and uses <=25% of independent connector bytes
gates.fail: either family retains <75% native AP or factorized transport is no better than shuffled-label control
gates.not_established: too few lexical positives (<30 in train or <10 in validation) or runtime/model failure

boundaries: Animal-word probe is a weak lexical concept test, not a semantic understanding claim.
PA241 warns output agreement does not imply information preservation; report each family separately.
Include model backbone, probes, dictionaries, connectors and metadata in full payload accounting.
